title: Diagnosis rule
description: One diagnosable failure signature. Regexes must stay within the RE2/JavaScript common subset (no lookbehind, no lookahead, no backreferences) because they are evaluated by both the Go CLI and the browser parser. All patterns are matched case-insensitively against individual log lines.

id.description: Unique id, '<format>/<slug>'. The file must live in rules/<format>/<slug>.json.

plain_english.description: What actually happened, written for a tired admin, not a protocol lawyer.

any.description: Rule matches if at least one of these regexes matches at least one line (and all 'all' patterns match).

all.description: Every one of these regexes must match at least one line.

priority.description: Higher = more specific/confident. When several rules match, matches are ordered by priority desc, then id asc. 100 = exact signature, 50 = generic pattern, 10 = catch-all.

next_check.description: One concrete action to confirm or eliminate this cause.

doc_slug.description: Optional slug of the companion knowledge-base page (web/src/content/kb/<slug>.md).
